title: repro check installs hooks in its probe but repro setup does not in run instances
goal: repro setup installs the kb's hooks in each instance clone (kbgit.py install-hooks), as repro check does in its probe, so the check proves the configuration the run uses. Found by the SP-ygsnog4n review (S4).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import inspect,bench_repro as b;s=inspect.getsource(b.setup);sys.exit(0 if 'install-hooks' in s else 1)

repro_reason: setup makes real clones; the defect is that setup never runs install-hooks
